title: 1638 Prairie's bay window, built to its photograph
items: The bay on the front of the Gothic house at 1638 Prairie Avenue is no longer a plain block: three tall pointed windows stand between its posts, on a panelled base and under a moulded cornice, as its photograph shows.
Its width now follows the photograph rather than the fire-insurance map's sketch, so it sits under the gable's twin windows where the picture puts it.
